adjudication.rationale: In the component save action, `props.category_id` is set from `this.get('categoryId')`, which is initialized to `null` for a new host unless the user picks a category. The server-side `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host` explicitly replaces a blank `category_id` with `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id`. However, on success the client does `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))`—still using the (possibly null) local `categoryId`, not the persisted `category_id` returned by the server—so `host.category` can become `undefined` and the badge can render empty until a reload/refetch.
